label: late original-phase / <DEL> accumulator of l, digits 2-3, h, p, i, g, r
explanation: Fires in the later part of the original phase (absolute t 4-9, peak t=6; orig_idx 5-7 at about 7x lift) and on the <DEL> step (14% of mass). It almost never fires at t<=2 or in the copy phase (1% of mass). It looks like an accumulator over a favored token set: the input token l (6.7x lift, 29% of mass), then digits 2/3, i, g, h, p and r, both as the current input and as earlier inputs (prev_tok/prev2_tok = 3 or l at about 4-5x). The rate also rises with n_digits and with L. The top activations are steps whose input is l, or that follow l/3, in sequences holding several favored tokens. The predicate (at least 3 favored tokens among inputs so far, t>=4, not the copy phase) catches about 82% of activation mass, but precision is only about 12%: many contexts that look the same do not cross threshold. The single best F1 on dev was only about 0.27 (in_tok l plus a prior favored token), so the description is coarse.
